body: General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI) has partnered with Saab to perform advanced flight testing of an Airborne Early Warning (AEW) system on an Uncrewed Aircraft System (UAS). The flight testing was conducted over the past few months using a GA-ASI-produced MQ-9B carrying a Saab LoyalEye radar operating from GA-ASI's Desert Horizon flight operations facility in Southern California. The flight test demonstrated simultaneous tracking of several airborne and maritime targets at long ranges. The airborne targets tracked included multiple instrumented red fighter jets and several commercial aircraft.

MQ-9B is GA-ASI's flagship UAS, offering unmatched endurance, type certification and all-weather performance. GA-ASI is discussing unmanned AEW capabilities on MQ-9B with several customers. “This has been one of the most highly anticipated flight tests we have performed,” said GA-ASI President David R. Alexander. “The level of customer interest in AEW capability on MQ-9B throughout the world is extremely high. It just makes sense.”

Saab's LoyalEye AEW radar was installed on GA-ASI's MQ-9B using payload pods. The AEW system is designed to provide persistent air surveillance. On the MQ-9B, it enables operators to use AEW in areas where it previously was unavailable, enhancing situational awareness while providing greater operational reach and flexibility without risking the loss of crew.
en.summary: General Atomics Aeronautical Systems and Saab have flight-tested Saab's LoyalEye airborne early warning radar on an MQ-9B, demonstrating simultaneous tracking of several airborne and maritime targets at long ranges.
en.title: GA-ASI and Saab flight-test LoyalEye AEW radar on MQ-9B, tracking jets at long range

body: 通用原子航空系統公司已與Saab合作，在無人飛行系統上完成空中預警系統的進階飛行測試。測試於過去數月進行，由一架搭載Saab的LoyalEye雷達的MQ-9B執行，並自GA-ASI位於南加州的飛行作業設施展開。測試證實可在遠距離同時追蹤數個空中與海上目標，空中目標包括多架儀器化紅方戰機與數架民航機。
MQ-9B是GA-ASI的旗艦無人機，具備長滯空、型別認證與全天候性能；GA-ASI正與數家客戶討論在MQ-9B上發展無人空中預警能力。GA-ASI總裁表示，這是該公司執行過最受期待的飛行測試之一，全球客戶對MQ-9B空中預警能力的興趣非常高。
Saab的LoyalEye空中預警雷達以酬載吊艙方式裝於MQ-9B，設計用於提供持續空中監視，使操作單位能在以往無法使用空中預警的區域運用該能力，同時提升態勢感知與作戰觸及範圍，且無須承擔機組人員損失風險。MQ-9B機型包括SkyGuardian與SeaGuardian，以及英國稱為Protector的版本與正在為航空母艦研發的短場起降構型。
zh.summary: 通用原子航空系統與Saab合作，在MQ-9B無人機上完成LoyalEye空中預警雷達的進階飛行測試；測試證實可在遠距離同時追蹤多個空中與海上目標，包括多架儀器化紅方戰機與數架民航機。
